claim_boundary: Development-split paired Basilisk residual prototypes. The classifier identifies an exact mode only when the available telemetry is distinguishable; otherwise it returns a frozen observational-equivalence class.

BATTERY_USABLE_CAPACITY_LOSS.reason: Both injections produce identical stored-energy and SOC residuals; battery temperature does not separate them.

DATA_STORAGE_CAPACITY_CLIP.reason: The current storage model exposes capacity clipping but no dropped-bit counter that separates queue overflow from capacity loss.

RF_ANALOG_LINK_DEGRADATION_UNLOCALISED.reason: Available end-to-end RF telemetry identifies analog-link degradation but not its unique source component or mechanism.

RF_SERVICE_LOSS_STORAGE_GROWTH.reason: Both mechanisms produce the same delivered-rate loss and storage-growth residuals.

RF_SERVICE_OUTAGE_UNLOCALISED.reason: The paired public telemetry residuals are exactly equal for these service-outage mechanisms.

RF_THROUGHPUT_DERATE.reason: Only end-to-end throughput derating is observed; the internal link/transmitter source is not measured.

RW_ACTUATION_ANOMALY_UNLOCALISED.reason: Wheel speed, command torque, and attitude residuals establish reaction-wheel authority loss but do not robustly identify mechanical versus motor root mode across severity changes.
